refnamediv.refpurpose: Function to create a new real leaf node

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoNodeCreateFromReal function generates a new real-number leaf node from source value.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoNodeCreateFromReal returns a pointer to a new leaf SilikoNode object with the value passed on success, or NULL if there was a memory error.
